lines.en: I step where my own foreclaws have been.

lines.zh: 我的鳞色跟兄弟都不一样。
lines.en: My scales differ from all my brothers.
I scurry low, wingtips brushing the floor.
At the corner I poke my head out first.
One flick of my tail and I follow you.
I keep to the wall's base, making no sound.
The floor is hot, so I hop along.

lines.zh: 我的步子很小，频率很快。
lines.en: My steps are short and quick.
I step over a crack.
This path leads deeper into the cave.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看你有没有跟。
lines.en: I keep checking that you are following.

lines.zh: 我绕了半圈才回到你脚边。
lines.en: I loop around before returning to your feet.
I sit with my tail wrapped around my hind legs.
I stare up at the cave roof.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀轻轻抖了一下。
lines.en: My wings twitch once.

lines.zh: 我竖着耳朵听岩缝滴水。
lines.en: I prick up my ears at water dripping in the rock.
I set my foreclaws one over the other.
This fire is nearly out.
I half close my eyes and pretend to doze.
I slowly lick my scales.

lines.zh: 我是在篝火的炭上孵出来的。
lines.en: I was hatched on the coals of a campfire.

lines.zh: 火把我的影子投在墙上。
lines.en: The fire throws my shadow onto the wall.
I wait for you to decide our route.
I tap the ground twice with my tail.

lines.zh: 我闻到了石头里的铁味。
lines.en: I smell iron inside the stone.
I tuck my neck down against my wing roots.
You are not quite like the others.
Of my clutch, I am the smallest.

lines.zh: 你手上还有龙蛋的味道。
lines.en: Your hands still smell of dragon egg.
Beside your feet I look even smaller.

lines.zh: 你把我抱起来时，我不挣扎。
lines.en: When you lift me, I do not struggle.

lines.zh: 我的颜色，暗处看不出来。
lines.en: My coloring does not show in the dark.

lines.zh: 我知道你不打算丢下我。
lines.en: I know you do not plan to leave me.

lines.zh: 你蹲下的时候我才抬头。
lines.en: I look up only when you crouch.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，尾巴尖在动。
lines.en: I blink slowly, my tail tip twitching.
How many pieces of meat did you bring today?
The moment you come in, I look up.
If you are afraid, you may touch me.
Do not swing the torchlight across my eyes.
My tail wags without my meaning it to.
You raise a hand, and I tilt my head for orders.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处有我不喜欢的声音。
lines.en: There are sounds deeper in I do not like.
I lie down and set my chin on the ground.
Do not stand too far off.

lines.zh: 我在这，就是为了跟着你。
lines.en: I am here to follow you, nothing more.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我尾巴摇得更快。
lines.en: You smiled, and my tail wags faster.
I curl up and roll aside.
One of my scales has cracked.
My cry comes out sharp.

lines.zh: 我伏在地上，又撑起前爪。
lines.en: I lie flat, then push up on my forepaws.
I flee toward you.
My wing droops.
The wound is between my scales, and it stings.
I pant hard, my body shaking.
I chirp low; do not come closer.
I haven't learned to breathe fire.
Is that chicken? I can tell.
Crouch down; do not feed me standing.
I take it, very carefully.
This mouthful is truly good.
After eating, I lick my lips.
I will take half back to my nest.
Hold your hand still; I am not done.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一口生兔肉就饱。
lines.en: This small, one raw rabbit fills me.
I carry it to the corner.
For this meat, I obey you.
I bump your ankle and bounce back.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的翼尖，我抽回来。
lines.en: You step on my wing tip, and I pull it free.
I turn about and clear the path.

lines.zh: 这么小的碰撞，不算什么。
lines.en: A bump so small is nothing.
I am squeezed against the wall.
I chirp low and step aside.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被蹭掉了一点粉。
lines.en: Some dust rubbed off my scales.
We are both stuck in this narrow gap.
I slide down along your leg.
I land and keep my feet.
I climb up your arm.
I sleep best here.

lines.zh: 你别把我从肩上拿下来。
lines.en: Do not take me off your shoulder.
We watch this fire together.
The sound of your breathing settles me.
I will keep watch for you.
I rest my head on the back of your hand.
With you here, the cave is not so deep.
Tomorrow we take the other path.

lines.zh: 我小声哼了一下，表示同意。
lines.en: I hum quietly in agreement.
I hold it in my mouth.
This is heavy; I dragged it halfway.
I carry it up onto your knee.
It glows. I like it.
I dug it out of the ash.
This is hard enough to hurt my teeth; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一卷，东西就过来。
lines.en: One curl of my tail brings it over.

lines.zh: 我先闻一圈，再决定拿不拿。
lines.en: I sniff all around it before deciding.
My claws cannot hold it any longer.
Take it; I have no need.
Something is shifting over there.
I flatten down, wings tight to my back.
I will approach from low.
It is bigger than me, but slower.
My mouth is starting to heat.
I will test it first.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，翅收起来。
lines.en: I slip behind it with my wings folded in.

lines.zh: 火焰冲击，先替你打出去。
lines.en: My fire burst goes out for you first.
I quiet my breathing.
This bite must land true.
Only a few paces from it.
If it turns, I dodge.
You take the front; I take the rear.

lines.zh: 我爪子扣住地，随时能扑。
lines.en: My claws grip the ground, ready to spring.
Its steps break rhythm, and I drop low.

lines.zh: 它背过身去的这一刻正好。
lines.en: The moment it turns its back is perfect.
I lie still where I am.
With each of its steps, I shift a little.
I wait for it to come near the rock.
My tail lies flat against the ground.
It cannot see scales in the dark.
I count the rhythm of its wings.
It draws nearer to the crack.
I inch my way behind it.
I have not spat fire yet.
Its breathing has grown rough.
A little more distance and it is enough.
Its shadow falls toward me.
I am in no hurry; I can wait.
It has finally lowered its head.
I dig my claws in harder.
I am ready to spring.
It is right there. Hold still.
Now. Right now.
I drop low and bite its ankle.

lines.zh: 一小团火从我嘴里出来。
lines.en: A small ball of fire leaves my mouth.
My claws rake hard plate and slide off.
It shakes me loose and I hit stone.
I roll up and charge again.
This bite went into something soft.
My flame caught the edge of its clothes.
It has turned to find me.
I slide away low along the floor.
I come back for a second bite.
Its blood spatters my scales.
I retreat to your feet, panting.
I put too much into that one.
I look up to confirm it has backed off.
Not done yet. I can still fight.
That last one did some good.
Of my clutch, I moved first.
I break out through a split shell.

lines.zh: 熔岩的红光落在我鳞上。
lines.en: Red lava light falls on my scales.

lines.zh: 我摔在石板上，翻了个身。
lines.en: I tumble onto the flagstones and right myself.

lines.zh: 这枚蛋被放在箱子里很久。
lines.en: That egg lay in a chest a long while.
I shake off the shell dust.

lines.zh: 我第一次闻到洞穴的味道。
lines.en: This is the first time I have smelled the cave.

lines.zh: 我从温热的灰里探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head out of the warm ash.
The firelight makes me squint.

lines.zh: 我试着站起来，腿还在抖。
lines.en: I try to stand, legs still trembling.

lines.zh: 这里比我出生的地方亮。
lines.en: This place is brighter than where I hatched.
I crawl toward the warmth.

lines.zh: 这屋里有生人味，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is a stranger's scent in this room; I smell it.
My wings unfurl little by little.
There are more shadows on the ground now.
I call out — very small.
Shell fragments lie under my feet.
I look at this new place.

lines.zh: 我本该不怕火，可这火不一样。
lines.en: I should not fear fire, but this fire is different.
I bent my tail on landing.
Water fills my throat and my legs stop.
A wave of heat flips me over.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的肩胛上。
lines.en: Something is lodged in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 有股冷气在我身体里绕。
lines.en: A cold vapor coils inside me.
I have missed two meals now.
The lightning flash blinds me.
In the dark there's no direction, only falling.
